errors.name: SelfFollow
errors.msg: A caller cannot tag their own trade

errors.name: InvalidHorizon
errors.msg: Call horizon is outside the market's locked bounds

errors.name: ConfigChanged
errors.msg: Configuration changed since the creation preview

errors.name: InvalidOracleProof
errors.msg: Price-history proof does not bracket the exact window edges

errors.name: UnsettledCallPositions
errors.msg: Every registered call position must settle before closing

errors.name: PositionRentPayerMismatch
errors.msg: The follower must pay their own position account rent

errors.name: CallSequenceChanged
errors.msg: This caller's call sequence changed; rebuild with their next call ID

errors.name: PositionStillActive
errors.msg: An active position must settle at its horizon before closing

errors.name: RecipientNeedsRent
errors.msg: The payout recipient must be rent-exempt; fund it or close the completed call to receive its rent and payout together

errors.name: BuyNotOpen
errors.msg: Buying opens in the slot after coin creation

fields.name: price_integral_hi
docs: High half of the 256-bit integral. Low-half compatibility does not limit
how long an otherwise valid high-price market can remain observable.

fields.name: evidence_missing
docs: A missing historical edge permanently selects the follower refund path.

types.name: CallerSequence
docs: A small durable replay marker scoped to one caller and market. It cannot
close, so closing a Call never allows the same address to be initialized
again. Other callers never change this sequence.

fields.name: created_slot
docs: Immutable creation slot. Every buyer waits until a strictly later slot.

types.name: MinuteObservation
docs: Explicit u64 limbs give identical eight-byte alignment on host and SBF.

types.name: PriceHistory
docs: Created once with the market. Trades borrow this data in place and never
allocate, resize, or depend on a keeper. Every retained record is the exact
cumulative price at a UTC minute boundary, including crossed quiet minutes.

fields.name: call_share_bps
docs: Fraction of the protocol share; never added to the trader's fee.
